title: docs(adr): ADR-0084 amended — App Studio is the entry for developing a package; two columns, no top bar

Fixes #37451

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Container & model: `S`, `mode:thread`, `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (mandatory for docs/adr/**; served at tier, read from the thread's session record)`, `effort: xhigh (ADR amendment, standing order)`

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：现在没有，这次只改架构记录的文字。它写定了 Studio 的新外框：去掉顶栏改成左右两栏，左上角恢复软件包切换器（带「新建软件包」），菜单第一项是「概览」，Studio 用自己的石墨色，以及顶栏上每个按钮搬去哪。
- 为什么做：第一阶段的四张界面卡都照这份记录施工，先写清楚，开发才不会各自猜。后面几个阶段的内容也一次写进去了，分阶段实施。
- 出错会怎样：不改代码，不改发布包。合并后发现措辞不对，再修订一次即可改回。
- 要你做什么：批准合入（受管文件，需要 os-zhuang 和 hotlong 批准）。问题 2、3 按你今天的裁定写成已定；问题 1、4、5 写成「待定」，没有替你定。表单按你说的「表单放常用」写成常用。请留意两处：「诊断」页搬到设置，和你 10 月 30 日说的「我认为还是应该在 studio」不一致（正文第 7 点，合并即按新的算）；表单在「常用」里排第几个你没说，正文写在报表之后、紧挨视图前面（正文第 11 点）。

## What changes

Two files, text only (+229 / −9 against `main` at `a46efa8c`). No code, no test, no changeset.

**`docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`** gains its third in-place amendment, dated 2026-11-26.

- The status line gets a third "Amended in place" entry, appended at its end, and the record gets a third note at the top. The title is unchanged, so the `docs/adr/README.md` row is unchanged (`check:adr-index` green).
- A new section, **Amendment (2026-11-26)**. Each part has its own anchor, so that a child card can cite the part it builds:

| Part | Anchor | Who cites it |
|---|---|---|
| What Studio is: the entry for developing a package; the name App Studio / 应用搭建 | `#amendment-2026-11-26-position` | every card |
| The frame: two columns, no top bar; Studio's row and the package row; the restored switcher with 新建软件包; the lock; the rail; the menu's look; graphite | `#amendment-2026-11-26-frame` | #37452, #37456 |
| Where the top bar's controls go (seven tenants, their homes) | `#amendment-2026-11-26-homes` | #37455, #37456 |
| 概览 Overview: first entry, no `package` metadata type, header, three tabs, what Pending counts, what phase 1 builds | `#amendment-2026-11-26-overview` | #37454 |
| Placements, and what moves to Setup (`dataset`, `position`, Diagnostics, the cross-package directory, `datasource`, and `form`) | `#amendment-2026-11-26-moves` | phase 3; #37087 |
| Organization-level content, as ruled on questions 2 and 3 | `#amendment-2026-11-26-org` | phase 4 |
| What the amendment replaces, and what stands | `#amendment-2026-11-26-stands` | reviewers |
| Open on #37424 — not decided here (questions 1, 4 and 5) | `#amendment-2026-11-26-open` | phases 2 and 3 |
| Written here where the rulings were silent (eleven numbered points) | `#amendment-2026-11-26-silent` | the approver |

- Nine marks on the earlier text, each pointing at the new section: TL;DR 4; the first two bullets of the 2026-11-24 "What Studio is"; the menu's drawing; the `datasource` reading; "Entries that are not a type"; the `dataset` row of the 2026-11-24 "What stands" table; item 1 of the 2026-11-24 list; the tiers paragraph of 2026-11-25.

**`docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md`** is touched in D1 only: a dated pointer in the status block; a mark on D1's scope sentence; one dated paragraph at the end of D1's 2026-11-24 amendment; and two short pointers to it, at "diagnostics" and at "no metadata catalog".

**Not touched, on purpose:** the rows of ADR-0084's type → group table. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` pins them, row by row, to the registry and the placement list. The ruled moves are written as prose, and the section says each row is rewritten, or written, in the change that moves it.

**The maintainer sources** (verbatim):

1. The order that opened the area for the epic, 2026-11-26 05:27Z: 「开一个专区处理专题 37424」
2. The pick on the area's decision card, 2026-11-26 05:57Z: 「按推荐启动」, whose recommended option read, as #37451 records it: 「返回放左上第二行，⋯和发布进概览页，保存/取消放详情页头，AI放标题行右端。」
3. Questions 2 and 3, 2026-11-26 06:44Z, in the area's thread: 「同意」, to the area's proposal to rule both as recommended. Ruling record: #37424 comment 7184753035.
4. The question on the `form` type, recorded on #37451 (comment 7184972402): 「Studio 菜单还没有 form 类型是吗？怎么规划？」
5. The tier of `form`, 2026-11-26 07:36Z, in the project chat: 「表单放常用」. Ruling record: #37451 comment 7185703578.

The maintainer's words on the design itself are the quotations in epic #37424's body; the new section quotes them where each one decides something.

**Read first** (by risk):

1. Item 7 of the new "silent" list, with ADR-0146 D1's new paragraph. Decision 12 of the epic moves the Diagnostics page to Setup; the 2026-10-30 ruling in ADR-0146 D1 put diagnostics in Studio. The text takes the later word for that one page and says which words to change if the earlier ruling is meant to hold.
2. "Organization-level content": check it against the ruling record, line by line. It adds nothing to the record.
3. The `form` point (the bullet under "Placements", and item 11). The tier is the maintainer's: common, a placement by name. The ruling does not give the type's place inside the tier; the text lists it last of the group's common types, after `report`, which is directly before `view`.
4. The "Open" part: questions 1, 4 and 5 should read as open, with what is in force until the answer.
5. The table of the top bar's seven tenants, and items 3 to 6 of the "silent" list.

**Two-minute verification**: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` → `Tests 12 passed (12)`. It reads ADR-0084 and proves the table pin still holds.

## Tests

n/a — `docs/adr/**` text. The one test that reads ADR-0084 was run and passes (above).

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's acceptance, line by line.** One PR amending ADR-0084 and the ADR-0146 wording that moves: this PR. Each phase-1 child card can cite a section: the table above. The body quotes the maintainer sources: above. "Questions 1 to 5 appear as open" was written before the 06:44Z ruling: questions 2 and 3 are now written as ruled, citing the record, and 1, 4 and 5 as open.
- **Rework at `44069a71`**, on the area's two notes after the first push. Organization-level content as ruled (the ruling record was posted while the first draft was being written). The `form` type's place, a scope addition on the card (comment 7184972402).
- **Rework at `6e55cbb8`**, on the maintainer's ruling 「表单放常用」 (record: #37451 comment 7185703578). `form` is written as a common type; the line that asked the question is gone from the "Open" part; item 11 now covers only the place inside the tier.
- **Past the card's words; each is a numbered item in the record, for the approver.**
  - The top bar holds seven things, not five. The menu's show/hide control goes to Studio's row (decision 3). The "create app" button for a package with no app is given no home (item 5). Below 768 px the menu is a drawer and a strip keeps its opener (item 4).
  - Decisions 8 and 12 are written, though the card lists 1–6 and 9–10 (item 9). The card's own summary asks for the Setup moves to be written once.
  - Diagnostics against the 2026-10-30 ruling (item 7).
  - Where the switcher lands and what it lists (item 3); Save and Cancel on a page that is not an item (item 6); where `form` goes (item 11).
- **`form`: the tier is ruled, the place inside it is this record's.** Group: the interface group, its registered domain. Tier: common, by the maintainer's words. Place: fifth of the group's common types, after `report`. The area had recommended the place directly after `view`; a common type cannot take it, because the menu lists a group's common types before its advanced fold, so the text puts `form` directly before `view` instead. ADR-0159 D10 says ADR-0084 needs no change for `form`; that was written before the table took one pinned row per type, and the "What stands" table says so. PR #37422 (card ② of ADR-0159) keeps `form` off Studio's directory, so the row is #37087's to write.
- **ADR-0146 is touched in more than one sentence.** The card speaks of "the one ADR-0146 sentence on the split". Decision 12 moves two things D1 gave Studio, and D1 would contradict ADR-0084 without a mark. The claim was amended before the edit (comment 7184713180 on #37451). Disabling, enabling and deleting a package are not moved: that is question 1.
- **ADR-0070 is not edited.** The ruling on questions 2 and 3 restates its D1 and D5; the text leaves those marks to the phase-4 cards that carry the ruling out.
- **The claim was written by this thread**, as the area's dispatch order asked (comment 7184414899), and amended once.
- **Tier H by path.** `docs/adr/**` (AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14): approvers os-zhuang and hotlong, and the maintainer merges. The PR stays a draft. The `Rule-change` line is left out, as the template asks for a diff that does not touch `.claude/**`.
- **No changeset.** `docs/adr/**` is not published; `skip-changeset` is declared with the create.

On the very first pass `check:doc-formula-expressions` exited 3 (a prerequisite was not built, nothing measured); after `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were built under the verify lock it exited 0, and on every head since.

The first commit's message was reworded before anything was published, because the pre-push hook refuses a commit message that names its card; no published history was rewritten.
- The table pin: `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts`, 12 of 12 passed on `6e55cbb8`, under the verify lock.
- Quotations: every 「…」 the diff adds was matched as a substring of its source (the epic's body, the card's body and comments, the ruling record, or ADR text already on `main`).
- `overlap-check.mjs` on `6e55cbb8`: clean against `origin/main` `a46efa8c` and 0 PR heads. PR #37422 was read by hand: it does not touch either file.
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: `docs/adr/**` is the mandatory contract tier; changed lines 238 against the human-merge threshold 3000: under.
- `check-prior-rulings --paths` on the two files at `a46efa8c`, read before the edit: the 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25 amendments are the rulings in force; this PR amends the first's position and top-left sentences on the maintainer's 2026-11-26 words and leaves the second's tier rule standing.
